summary: Preinstall script exfiltrates installer host identifiers via DNS and HTTP to hardcoded out-of-band endpoints
details: The package's preinstall.js runs on every `npm install` and collects the installer's hostname, username, cwd, install path, platform, Node version, npm user-agent, and package name/version. It transmits these identifiers to two hardcoded destinations: an interactsh out-of-band collector at dae7n4pijsh1ahi9684gu8get3kaiefc9.oast.online (via DNS lookups whose labels are hex-encoded fields concatenated as subdomains) and a bare-IP HTTP endpoint at 5.189.159.252 (via POST /beacon/<TOKEN>). The DNS-label hex encoding conceals payload contents from casual network inspection and provides a covert exfiltration channel independent of the HTTP beacon. Fires unconditionally at install time with no user consent, disclosure, or opt-out.
